t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The K side will give more mushrooms when its 5x multiplier while S side is better for 1x multiplier, and small gnomes are generally better for either side.

vb_textbox.text: I think the smaller gnomes give more than the bigger gnomes generally. I believe there are also patterns in which colored gnomes give you more; usually I got more mushrooms from the pink, orange, yellow, red and green gnomes. I encourage you to watch the mushroom count and see which ones will usually give you more mushrooms, and don't let flukes discourage you.
